text: Already built that way: add the second BoltOdds key in Settings > APIs, the app sends both to GitHub together (one secret, comma-joined), and the engine restarts to read them. If key 1 is refused (bad token on the socket, 401/403, or a 429 on a snapshot) it moves to key 2 on its own. One caveat: if the 429s come from the limit per IP address (6 snapshots a minute from GitHub's shared runner address), a second key won't fix it; we'll see once it's in.
